runs.label: loop-pegasus
runs.prompt: A locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. The painting gently comes alive; keep exactly the same art style, colours, brushwork and paper or canvas texture in every frame, never 3D, never photographic. The top and bottom edges of the picture stay still. A seamless loop. A heroic oil painting: Pegasus holds its pose high in the sky, its great white wings rising and falling slowly and gently like breathing, the feather tips stirring, its mane and tail streaming strongly in the wind. The sunlight glimmers and the clouds below churn and drift slowly. Majestic and slow.

Soft mist flows slowly between the mountain peaks. The waterfall flows. The mountains stay still. Serene and slow.

runs.label: loop-kitsune
runs.prompt: A locked-off static camera: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. The painting gently comes alive; keep exactly the same art style, colours, brushwork and paper or canvas texture in every frame, never 3D, never photographic. The torii gates, the steps and the stone fox stay perfectly still. Quiet and slow.
